title: Free-category resolution augmentation after adjoining an ordinary category
statement:
Let $O$ be a small set and let $A,C$ be small ordinary categories [def-nagata-category] with object set $O$. All functors considered below fix $O$. For categories on $O$, write $D*_O E$ for their coproduct among categories with object set $O$ and functors fixing $O$: its arrows are composable words of arrows from the two factors, modulo the composition and identity relations within each factor. Let $F$ be the free-category comonad on these categories. The category $FD$ has object set $O$ and one graph generator $[d]:x\to y$ for every nonidentity arrow $d:x\to y$ of $D$; its arrows are finite composable words of generators, including empty words as identities. For a functor $u:D\to E$, the functor $Fu:FD\to FE$ sends $[d]$ to $[u(d)]$ if $u(d)$ is nonidentity and to the identity otherwise. The counit $\epsilon_D:FD\to D$ composes a word; the comultiplication $\delta_D:FD\to F^2D$ sends $[d]$ to $[[d]]$. Define the augmented simplicial category $F_\bullet C\to C$ by $(F_\bullet C)_n=F^{n+1}C$, faces $d_i=F^i\epsilon F^{n-i}$ and degeneracies $s_i=F^i\delta F^{n-i}$ for $0\leq i\leq n$. Regard $A$ and $A*_O C$ as constant simplicial categories, and set $R_n=A*_O F^{n+1}C$, with operators identity on $A$ and the indicated operators on the other factor. For every $x,y\in O$, composition of the nested words induces a weak homotopy equivalence of simplicial sets [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], [lem-coef-kan-quillen-right-proper]
$$R_\bullet(x,y)\longrightarrow\operatorname{const}\bigl((A*_O C)(x,y)\bigr).$$
There is no freeness or cofibrancy hypothesis on $A$ or $C$.

source.place: Dwyer--Kan, Simplicial localizations of categories, Section 2.4 (free-category comonad), Section 2.5 (standard resolution), Proposition 2.6, and proof of Proposition 2.7(iii), printed pp.270-271, specialized to constant A and C. Read online, not archived locally. No Stacks tag states this enriched-category resolution comparison.
